# table: `TableSlice`

The `data` payload of `openreadout table FILE --json` (FCS: `--compensate`, `--transform`, `--population`), inside the [envelope](envelope.md).

A slice of a table as rows, for JSON consumers (`openreadout_table`).

JSON Schema: [`docs/schema/table.schema.json`](https://github.com/openreadout/openreadout/blob/main/docs/schema/table.schema.json) · also printed by `openreadout self schema table`.

## Fields

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | `string` | yes | The input file. |
| `format` | `string` | yes | Format id of the input file. |
| `table` | `integer` (uint32) | yes | Table index (see `info` → `tables[]`). |
| `first_row` | `integer` (uint64) | yes | Zero-based index of the first row returned. |
| `total_rows` | `integer` (uint64) | yes | Rows in the whole table. |
| `columns` | array of `string` | yes | Column names (FCS `$PnN`). |
| `labels` | array of `string` or `null` | yes | Column labels (FCS `$PnS`), `null` where absent. |
| `rows` | array of array of `number` (double) | yes | Row-major values; `rows[r][c]`. Non-finite values serialize as `null`. |
| `truncated` | `boolean` | yes | True when more rows follow the returned slice. |
| `processing` | [`TableProcessing`](#tableprocessing) or `null` |  | Present when the values were processed (FCS scale values, compensation, transforms, population membership columns); absent for raw values. |
| `filter` | [`TableFilterSummary`](#tablefiltersummary) or `null` |  | Present with `--where`/`--count`: the row conditions and how many rows of the whole table meet them. `rows`, `first_row` and `truncated` then page through the matching rows. |

## Types

### TableProcessing

What `table` did to the raw values before returning them.

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `scale` | array of `string` | yes | Channel-to-scale conversions applied (`$PnE`, `$PnG`, `$TIMESTEP`); every processed table starts from scale values. |
| `compensation` | [`CompensationSummary`](#compensationsummary) or `null` |  | The compensation applied, if any. |
| `transforms` | array of [`AppliedTransform`](#appliedtransform) | yes | Transforms applied, by parameter. |
| `gates` | array of [`GateColumn`](#gatecolumn) | yes | Membership columns appended (1 = in the population, 0 = not). |

### CompensationSummary

A compensation or unmixing matrix.

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | `string` | yes | Matrix name or id; `$SPILLOVER`/`$SPILL`/`SPILL` for the FCS file's own. |
| `source` | `string` | yes | Where it comes from: `workspace`, `gating-ml`, `fcs` or `command-line`. |
| `detectors` | array of `string` | yes | Detectors (columns), `$PnN`. |
| `fluorochromes` | array of `string` | yes | Rows: fluorochromes, or the detectors that receive the unmixed values. |
| `matrix` | array of array of `number` (double) | yes | Row-major coefficients (spillover fractions). |
| `spectral` | `boolean` | yes | More detectors than rows: unmixed by ordinary least squares. |
| `used` | `boolean` | yes | Whether a gate (or the table) used it. |

### AppliedTransform

A transform applied to one table column.

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `parameter` | `string` | yes | Column (`$PnN`). |
| `kind` | `string` | yes | Transform kind. |
| `parameters` | object: string → `number` (double) | yes | Its parameters. |

### GateColumn

A population membership column.

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `column` | `string` | yes | Column name in the table (`gate:<path>`). |
| `population` | `string` | yes | Population path. |
| `gating_file` | `string` | yes | Path of the workspace or Gating-ML file that defines the population. |
| `count_in_rows` | `integer` (uint64) | yes | Members among the returned rows. |

### TableFilterSummary

Rows of a whole table that meet every condition (`table --where`, `--count`).

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `conditions` | array of `string` | yes | The conditions as parsed (`FITC-A > 1000`), all of which a row must meet. Empty with `--count` alone (every row counts). |
| `matched_rows` | `integer` (uint64) | yes | Rows of the whole table that meet every condition (not only the returned page). |
| `total_rows` | `integer` (uint64) | yes | Rows in the whole table. |
| `percent` | `number` (double) | yes | `matched_rows / total_rows × 100` (0 for an empty table). |
| `values` | `string` | yes | The values the conditions were tested on: `raw` (as stored) or `processed` (FCS scale values after compensation/transforms; see `processing`). |
